title: Simplifying the <i>Centrolene buckleyi</i> complex (Amphibia: Anura: Centrolenidae): a taxonomic review and description of two new species.

readScopes.readScope: Centrolene elisae: Diagnosis, stream observations, three staged egg clutches, single field recording versus separate interacting laboratory male, four-locality conservation proposal and unresolved mitochondrial polytomy; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Centrolene marcoreyesi: Six-male diagnosis with unknown females, stream habitat and one egg clutch, historical and modern acoustic context, uncertain tape elevation, four localities, threatened-status proposal and mitochondrial sister relationship; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Centrolene buckleyi: Restricted sensu-stricto diagnostic sample and appearance, uncertain countries and revised historic assignments, two attributed recordings and untested social-call explanation; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
